_comment: SAVA (Inworld) per-tensor tolerances for compare_tensors.py.
Regime, identical for every number below:
model     models/sava/sava-F32.gguf (ALL_F32; the bf16 release weights, exact)
runtime   build/bin/transcribe-cli --backend cpu --threads 1 (transcribe_turn_run:
the clip fed whole plus 3 silent flush steps; production path, nothing
injected). Per-step tensors are [n_frames + 3, ...].
reference inworld-sava 1.0.0 (git v1.0.0 b4221a5), weights inworld/sava@1beae7c1,
torch 2.14.1, fp32, CPU, 1 thread, inworld.sava.run
host      macOS / arm64 (Apple M1), ggml CPU backend
cases     all 8 in tests/golden/sava/sava.manifest.json (speech, silence, noise, ja,
884 frames, 306 s / 7651 steps)
Recipe, per tensor, over all 8 cases:
finalized = max(1.5 * observed, provisional, 1e-6)
with provisional = 1e-4 * p99_abs (max) / 1e-5 * rms (mean) from the reference dumps.
C++ compute: front end on the host in fp64 (FFT, power, mel bank, log10), the rest
fp32 ggml; RoPE angles in fp64 from the absolute int64 step index (owner decision),
the reference uses fp32 angles.
WIDENED vs provisional (max_abs unless noted):
fe.mel               max  observed 7.887e-04 (dots-full) -> 0.001183 (provisional 0.00015)
head.turn.hidden     max  observed 6.857e-04 (dots-full) -> 0.001029 (provisional 0.0003921)
head.turn.input      max  observed 3.811e-04 (dots-full) -> 0.0005717 (provisional 0.0002687)
head.vad.hidden      max  observed 5.609e-04 (dots-full) -> 0.0008413 (provisional 0.0003867)
trunk.1.ssm_state    max  observed 3.785e-05 (dots-full) -> 5.677e-05 (provisional 1.608e-05)
trunk.1.ssm_y        max  observed 2.213e-04 (jfk) -> 0.0003319 (provisional 0.0003142)
trunk.2.mix          mean observed 7.452e-05 (silence) -> 0.0001118 (provisional 7.819e-05)
trunk.2.out          mean observed 2.188e-04 (silence) -> 0.0003282 (provisional 0.0002916)
trunk.2.ssm_state    max  observed 1.364e-04 (silence) -> 0.0002046 (provisional 5.233e-05)
trunk.2.ssm_y        max  observed 2.403e-03 (dots-full) -> 0.003605 (provisional 0.001985)
trunk.3.out          max  observed 2.627e-02 (dots-full) -> 0.0394 (provisional 0.02072)
trunk.norm           max  observed 3.811e-04 (dots-full) -> 0.0005716 (provisional 0.0002734)
Mechanisms:
fe.mel: the REFERENCE's own error. Its DFT is an fp32 GEMM, so bins near the
1e-10 mel floor (band-limited recordings, high bins) are cancellation-bound.
The C++ fp64 front end matches an fp64 NumPy derivation to 6e-8; every bit of
the observed drift is reference - exact (dots-full 7.9e-4, jfk 2.7e-4).
dots-full (positions up to 7650): the reference's fp32 RoPE angles lose
precision with stream age (its own outputs at a 7650-frame offset move 3.3e-5
in probability, docs/porting/families/sava.md); with fp64 angles the C++ is
the shift-invariant value. Drift grows with position (sava.speech 4e-6 in the
first 1000 frames, 3.9e-5 after 6000; with fp32 angles in the C++ it stays
at 1.2e-5). trunk.3.out (|x| up to 718) adds fp32 accumulation order in the
2048-term FFN down projection: 2.6e-2 on a value of -34 in a row whose max is
212 (trunk.2.out 2.5e-3, trunk.3.mix 7e-4 in that row).
trunk.{1,2}.ssm_state / ssm_y: the reference's offline path is the chunked SSD
algorithm (exp of 64-step cumulative log-decay sums); ggml_ssm_scan is the
exact recurrence. Largest on digital silence (constant input).
Gates beyond tensors (validate.py, all 8 cases): the clip score p within 1e-4
(observed <= 2.7e-6) and the same decision. Before the API dropped turn
segments (API review) they were also identical to sava.segment, all 59 on
dots-full (a pause-frame turn score there is 2.9e-6 from 0.9). Products observed:
sava.speech 3.9e-5, sava.turn 2.6e-5 (dots-full); <= 6.7e-6 on the short cases.
